content.short: NTM.ai tracks new token listings, trending assets, contract data, and project promotion opportunities.
content.description: NTM.ai, or New Token Market, is a token discovery and listing platform. Its site shows new listings, trending tokens, a crypto tracker, contract scanner tools, academy content, and promotion options for projects. The TON listing is best read as a discovery and market-information app rather than a chat-first SocialFi product. Join NTM.ai to explore global listing announcements, express listings, and partnership opportunities. The app presents new listings, trending, and cryptotracker as core parts of the workflow.
